rationale: This randomized interventional study explicitly includes a placebo comparator in the double-blind period. Participants are assigned to pridopidine or placebo for 48 weeks, then all receive pridopidine in the open-label extension, so placebo is used in part of the study.
title: Pridopidine Phase 3 Study to Evaluate Efficacy and Safety in ALS
